PlcFunction.Name: NoFaultOut
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output Signal from Acorn (to a drive EStop contactor etc.) indicating that Acorn is okay and is not in an EStop condition.

PlcFunction.Name: LubePump
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output that controls an automatic lube pump (See parameter 179 for more info).

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleBrakeRelease
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A relay output used to control a spindle brake. CNC12 applies the brake release when the spindle is commanded to run (M3 or M4). Brake is ON in all other cases. Premapped to Aux 7 for operator convenience for manual tool changes.

PlcFunction.Name: SpinFWD
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Relay output used to command spindle forward. Typically used with a VFD (or contactor/relay). See Acorn wiring schematics (M3 FWD M5 Off).

PlcFunction.Name: SpinREV
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Relay output used to command spindle reverse. Typically used with a VFD (or contactor/relay). See Acorn wiring schematics (M4 REV M5 Off).

PlcFunction.Name: DriveResetOut
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An output used to clear faults from a drive. CNC12 cycles this output when EStop or reset is cycled. The signal tells drive to reset and clear any faults.

PlcFunction.Name: Flood
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Flood pump on/off relay output (M8 on M9 off).

PlcFunction.Name: TurnClampOn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A relay output used to control a clamp (M10 on M11 off).

PlcFunction.ConfigLine: IF True_M THEN RST G540SpindleStage, SET StandardSpindleStage
PlcFunction.Name: G540SpinRevOff
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Legacy G540 spindle control output (used when controlling the spindle through a G540).

PlcFunction.ConfigLine: IF True_M THEN RST G540SpindleStage, SET StandardSpindleStage
PlcFunction.Name: G540SpinFwdOff
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Legacy G540 spindle control output (used when controlling the spindle through a G540).

PlcFunction.Name: Mist
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Mister solenoid on/off relay output (M7 on M9 off).

PlcFunction.Name: VacuumOn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An output relay to turn on/off a vacuum hold down (M33 on M34 off).

PlcFunction.Name: DustCollectionOn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An output relay to turn on/off a dust collector contactor/relay (M35 on M36 off).

PlcFunction.Name: OpenChuck
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
A relay output used to a open a chuck (M10 on). It looks for ChuckIsOpen input or times out according to parameter 992 and then turns off the relay.
Parameter 992 is a timer (in ms) for Turnoff, or Fault if ChuckIsOpen Input is selected. M10 turns on OpenChuck, which turns off when the timer or input is seen. M10 Turns off M11. See the Chuck appendix attached to this document.

PlcFunction.Name: CloseChuck
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A relay output used to close a chuck (M11 on). It looks for ChuckIsClosed input or times out according to parameter 992 and then turns off relay.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT1
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M61 to turn relay 1 on and M81 to turn relay 1 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT2
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M62 to turn relay 2 on and M82 to turn relay 2 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT3
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M63 to turn relay 3 on and M83 to turn relay 3 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT4
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M64 to turn relay 4 on and M84 to turn relay 4 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT5
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M65 to turn relay 5 on and M85 to turn relay 5 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT6
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M66 to turn relay 6 on and M86 to turn relay 6 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT7
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M67 to turn relay 7 on and M87 to turn relay 7 off.

PlcFunction.Name: OUTPUT8
PlcFunction.Tooltip: General purpose output used to turn a relay on/off. Uses M68 to turn relay 8 on and M88 to turn relay 8 off.

PlcFunction.Name: CutOff
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output that controls a parts cutoff device commonly found on lathes (M27 on). Looks for CutOffIsDown input to close or times out according to parameter 995 and then turns off relay (M28 forces output off).

PlcFunction.Name: PartChute
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output that controls a parts catcher commonly found on lathes (M22 on). Looks for PartChuteIsIn input or times out according to parameter 994 and then turns off relay (M23 forces output off).

PlcFunction.Name: Axis1BrakeRelease
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Brake control output for an axis brake. Releases brake when axis motor power is enabled and applies the brake when axis motor enable is removed. Typically not IsRequired if axis motor/drives have a builtin brake.

PlcFunction.Name: Axis2BrakeRelease
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Brake control output for an axis brake. Releases brake when axis motor power is enabled and applies the brake when axis motor enable is removed. Typically not IsRequired if axis motor/drives have a builtin brake.

PlcFunction.Name: Axis3BrakeRelease
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Brake control output for an axis brake. Releases brake when axis motor power is enabled and applies the brake when axis motor enable is removed. Typically not IsRequired if axis motor/drives have a builtin brake.

PlcFunction.Name: Axis4BrakeRelease
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Brake control output for an axis brake. Releases brake when axis motor power is enabled and applies the brake when axis motor enable is removed. Typically not IsRequired if axis motor/drives have a builtin brake.

PlcFunction.Name: ChargePump
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A signal that tells a G540 stepper drive that it is good to run and everything is ok. Charge pump is only available on Output number 3.

PlcFunction.Name: UnclampTool
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output used to release the tool drawbar to unclamp the tool.

PlcFunction.Name: OrientSpindle
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Used to send output signal to orient card to go ahead and orient the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: EStopOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: EStop button input. Connect EStop according to Acorn schematics.

PlcFunction.Name: FirstAxisHomeLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for a combination home and limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: SecondAxisHomeLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for a combination home and limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: ThirdAxisHomeLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for a combination home and limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FourthAxisHomeLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for a combination home and limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: DriveOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Signal from axis drive letting Acorn know axis drive is okay with no faults.

PlcFunction.Name: ProbeDetect
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used to let CNC12 know that a touch probe is plugged in and in use. This enables Probe protection. See probe setup guide.

PlcFunction.Name: ProbeTripped
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Touch probe tripped input (see probe setup guide for more info).

PlcFunction.Name: BackGear
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Switch input to indicate to CNC12 that the machine is in BackGear so CNC12 will know to reverse the spindle direction automatically (M3 CW and M4 CCW).

PlcFunction.Name: LubeOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Low oil level indicator switch input.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Signal from spindle drive letting Acorn know spindle drive is okay with no faults.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleLowRange
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used for a low range indicator switch. Tells CNC12 that machine is in low spindle range.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleMedRange
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used for a medium range indicator switch. Tells CNC12 that machine is in medium spindle range.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleHighRange
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used for a high range indicator switch. Tells CNC12 that machine is in high spindle range.

PlcFunction.Name: FirstAxisHomeOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual home switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: SecondAxisHomeOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual home switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: ThirdAxisHomeOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual home switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FourthAxisHomeOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual home switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FirstAxisMinusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FirstAxisPlusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: SecondAxisMinusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: SecondAxisPlusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: ThirdAxisMinusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: ThirdAxisPlusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FourthAxisMinusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: FourthAxisPlusLimitOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Individual input for an individual limit switch (use HomeAll and/or LimitAll to save on inputs).

PlcFunction.Name: ChuckIsOpen
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Chuck open indicator switch input tells CNC12 that the chuck is open.

PlcFunction.Name: ChuckIsClosed
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Chuck closed indicator switch input tells CNC12 that the chuck is closed.

PlcFunction.Name: CutOffIsDown
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A switch input that tells CNC12 that the Cut Off device has completed its stroke.

PlcFunction.Name: PartChuteIsIn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: A switch input that tells CNC12 that the part chute has retracted.

PlcFunction.Name: HomeAll
PlcFunction.Tooltip: One Input for all home switches. This is the preferred Acorn method of homing.

PlcFunction.Name: LimitAll
PlcFunction.Tooltip: One input for all limit switches. This is often used in conjunction with HomeAll.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTouchOffTriggered
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Tool Touch Off device input. See probe setup guide for more info.

PlcFunction.Name: SlavedHomeInput
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Home switch input used for autosquaring of paired axes on slave axis side used in conjunction with HomeAll. See paired axis and squaring setup guide for more info.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTouchOffDetect
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Input used to let CNC12 know that a Tool Touch Off device is plugged in and in-use. This enables probe protection. See probe setup guide for more info.
See Touch Probe Setup Manual for more detailed information.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolIsUnclamped
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used with a sensor to verify that the tool is actually unclamped typically used with ATC spindles.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleIsOriented
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An input from a VFD orient card which indicates that the spindle is oriented. Typically used for ATCs.

PlcFunction.Name: SafetyDoorSwitchClosed_I
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Door closed confirmation input. Typically for a machine tool safety door switch, but could also be used for another safety device’s input.
See Acorn Door Interlock Safety documentation for more details. P985 = 1, Allows slow jog with the door open P985 = 2, Does not allow any movement with the door open

PlcFunction.Name: SafetyDoorLockConfirmed_I
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Safety Door Locked confirmation Input used for machine tool safety. Typically for a door lock with an auto locking mechanism. See Acorn Door Interlock Safety documentation for more details

PlcFunction.Name: SafetyDoorLockOpen_O
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Used to energize a lock solenoid to allow the safety door to be opened.
See Acorn Door Interlock Safety documentation for more details. Energized when not running a job. If P985 = 1, will unlock door if feedhold and spindle is not on, If p985 = 2 only unlocks if no job in progress.

PlcFunction.Name: VFDEnable_O
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Industry standard way of commanding spindle VFD enable. Output used to enable a VFD. Lets VFD know that it is good to go.
Used in conjunction with VfdDirection. See schematics. Here is one example.

PlcFunction.Name: VFDDirection_O
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Industry standard way of commanding spindle VFD direction. The Output is activated when motor direction is commanded to reverse (M4). Allows a SPDT output relay to VFD connection ( just like Allin1DC and Oak) to command the Spindle direction rather than having two dedicated relays when using the alternative SpinFwd and SpinRev outputs. . controlled by M3/4, VCP spindle CW/CCW buttons. See Wiring Schematics. Here is one example.

PlcFunction.Name: VFDResetOut_O
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Output used to reset a VFD after a fault.
Output is Active (Green) with Physical E-Stop depressed (E-Stop condition from the actual E-Stop button input). Output is inactive (RED) when E-Stop is released. See schematic S15008.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolUnclampButton
PlcFunction.Tooltip: External Button wired to input to activate ToolUnclamp.

PlcFunction.Name: VFDZeroSpeed
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input from VFD to confirm that spindle has stopped. Used in G code and Tool change macros.

PlcFunction.Name: VFDUpToSpeed
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input from VFD to confirm that spindle has reached the specified speed. Used in G code and Tool Change macros.

PlcFunction.Name: DrawBarReleased
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An input that is typically used on ATC router spindles. Input is active when Draw Bar/Pull Stud is active indicating that the tool is released from the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: RouterDustCollection
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Output to control (ON/OFF) a Dust Collection motor through a relay or contactor.
Works exactly like Flood, uses M8/M9 and uses same button on the VCP as Flood. Can’t assign Flood and DustCollection at same time.

PlcFunction.Name: RouterVacuumHoldDown
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control (on/off) material Vacuum hold down typically air solenoid.

PlcFunction.Name: DustFootActivate
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control (on/off) dust foot.

PlcFunction.Name: LaserAlignActivate
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control (on/off) cross hair material alignment laser marking.

PlcFunction.Name: PopUpPins
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control (on/off) material alignment pins typically air solenoid.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleCooling
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control (on/off) spindle cooling typically a fan or water pump.

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleTempAlarmMessage
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input for Temperature Alarm issue message when input is Active finishes current G code job (does not stop current Job that is running).

PlcFunction.Name: SpindleTempAlarmStop
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input for Temperature Alarm Issues Estop condition when input is active.

PlcFunction.Name: AirPressureLowMessage
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Input for Low Pressure Alarm. Issues a message when the input is active, and continues to run until the G-code job is complete.
Works just like the Low Lube Level Indicator Input. Issues a warning message and continues to run until the job is complete.

PlcFunction.Name: AirPressureLowStop
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input for a low-pressure sensor. Issues a message and E-Stop condition when the input is active.

PlcFunction.Name: WorkLight
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output for a Worklight Starts On at Powerup

PlcFunction.Name: AirBlowNozzle
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Activates the general purpose Air Blow Nozzle Output.

PlcFunction.Name: ColletOpenClose
PlcFunction.Tooltip: An output typically used for the 5C collet open/close function. This output is typically used for a Dunham-style air-operated chuck. Note: Output and VCP button skinevent 74 uses OUT1130 for the LED. See the Chuck Appendix attached to this document.

PlcFunction.Name: GreenLight

PlcFunction.Name: AmberLight

PlcFunction.Name: RedLight

PlcFunction.Name: LaserEnable
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Output to control the Safety Interlock Circuit of a diode laser, such as with a J-Tech diode laser.
M37 - Enables safety interlock and resets the laser.
M38 - Disables safety interlock after a delay to allow the component cool down.
See Acorn to Laser schematics for typical use.

PlcFunction.Name: PWMSelect
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to enable PWM

PlcFunction.Name: LaserReset
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to send a reset signal to the Safety Interlock Circuit of a laser, such as with a J-Tech laser. Momentary output to reset the laser. See Acorn to Laser schematics for typical use.

PlcFunction.Name: PWMOutput
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Pulse Width Modulation Output for lasers and spindles PWM signal output. Note: For Acorn only: Only available on Output #2 DB25 connector Pin #14 and Relay 2 is sacrificial and must be disconnected and cannot be used when using PWM Output. See Laser Hookup schematics for typical use.

PlcFunction.Name: ChuckFootPedal_I
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Lathe Chuck Foot Pedal input, When the Input is Closed (Green), it will toggle between Chuck Open/Close or ColletOpenClose ON/OFF

PlcFunction.Name: ZriHomingAll
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input to Home at Index Pulse for all Axes.

PlcFunction.ConfigLine: IF True_M THEN RST RPM_Sensor, SET RPMSensorDisabled_M
PlcFunction.Name: RPM_Sensor
PlcFunction.Tooltip:
Input for a one pulse-per-revolution Spindle Speed Indicator. Generally only used for machines that lack a spindle encoder.
Typically used with Hall Effect sensors (Note: cannot be used for threading. Threading requires a spindle encoder, and a spindle encoder and RPM_Sensor cannot be used at the same time. If an encoder is installed, CNC12 reads the spindle speed from the encoder, and an RPM_Sensor is not necessary. An RPM_Sensor is for machines without a spindle encoder where the user wishes to have a true spindle RPM readout within CNC12 displayed on the main screen. This input is located in the Wizard Input Definitions Menu.

PlcFunction.Name: CAxisEnable
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output used to enable the C-axis drive.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretPosBit1
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Up to four inputs can be used as bits to determine the current active tool from the ATC. Typically used with a Lathe Turret. These four bits are used in combination to express the currently selected tool.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretPosBit2
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Up to four inputs can be used as bits to determine the current active tool from the ATC. Typically used with a Lathe Turret. These four bits are used in combination to express the currently selected tool.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretPosBit3
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Up to four inputs can be used as bits to determine the current active tool from the ATC. Typically used with a Lathe Turret. These four bits are used in combination to express the currently selected tool.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretPosBit4
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Up to four inputs can be used as bits to determine the current active tool from the ATC. Typically used with a Lathe Turret. These four bits are used in combination to express the currently selected tool.

PlcFunction.Name: RotateToolTurret
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control rotation ON/OFF of tool turret, typically used with Lathe turrets

PlcFunction.Name: ReverseToolTurret
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to reverse the direction of the tool turret, typically used with Lathe turrets.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretCounter
PlcFunction.Tooltip: This input is used to count the current turret position, typically used with a Lathe Turret.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretSyncBit
PlcFunction.Tooltip: This input is used for homing ‘Counter’ and ‘Timer’ based turrets M18 rotates the turret to seek the turret home switch and waits for ToolTurretSyncBit to trigger, then sets the current turret tool position to 1. Typically used with a Lathe Turret.

PlcFunction.Name: ToolTurretEnable
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to enable the Tool Turret, typically a lathe turret.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselForward
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to control the ATC Carousel in the Forward direction so that it counts up in tools (1 → 2 → 3 → etc.)

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselReverse
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to command the ATC Carousel in the Reverse direction so that it counts down in tools (4 → 3 → 2 → etc.)

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_ToolCounter
PlcFunction.Tooltip: The input that is used as a tool index counter sensor from the ATC, which is only used for carousel or tool arm.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselIsIn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: The input from the ATC Carousel sensor that indicates the carousel is in the IN position toward the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselIsOut
PlcFunction.Tooltip: The input from the ATC Carousel sensor that indicates the carousel is in the OUT position away from the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselOut
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output used to activate the ATC carousel to move away from the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_CarouselIn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output used to activate the ATC carousel to move in toward the spindle.

PlcFunction.Name: ATC_AirPressureOk
PlcFunction.Tooltip: The input that is used for detecting if the Air Pressure is at an acceptable level to continue with work, perform a tool change etc.

PlcFunction.Name: OscillationOn
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to turn on oscillation mode for use with a tangential knife

PlcFunction.Name: DSPProbe_I
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Touch probe tripped input from a DSP Probe also used by the DP7 Probe.

PlcFunction.Name: LaserCooling_Fan
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output for use with a Laser Cooling Fan Turns on with M37 (LaserEnable)

PlcFunction.Name: HomeLimitAll

PlcFunction.Name: EStopOk2

PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used to let CNC12 know that a touch Plate is plugged in and in use.

PlcFunction.Name: TouchPlateTripped

PlcFunction.Name: AutoSquareRelayForHardPair

PlcFunction.Tooltip: Input used for the Plasma cutter Arc box signal, letting CNC12 know that the Plasma arc is OK. See Plasma Operator manual for more info.

PlcFunction.Name: TorchFloatSwitch_I

PlcFunction.Name: ToolRackOut_O
PlcFunction.Tooltip: Output to move a sliding Tool Rack Out (Away from Spindle).

PlcFunction.Name: LaserDeploy_O
